input_boundary: sealed_submission/showcase.mp4; agent-input/audio/*.wav; private/audio-events.json source SFX duration/effective interval/onset/peak/anchor and BGM duration only

music_alignment.selection: highest positive global overlap NCC squared times overlap fraction; retain all supported offset aliases
music_alignment.gain: per-channel-independent mono LS; local 0.8s LS, 0.6s median, 0.15s Gaussian smoothing, clipped 0..4*global positive gain

sfx_retrieval.template: annotated source effective interval; unchanged rate and positive waveform correlation
sfx_retrieval.fallback: if no retrieved peak, retain best two nonadjacent peaks as below-threshold hypotheses
sfx_retrieval.ranking: residual NCC * sqrt(max(incremental mix variance explained,0)) + 0.05*raw NCC
sfx_retrieval.high_confidence: residual NCC>=0.50 and incremental mix variance explained>=0.010
sfx_retrieval.medium_confidence: residual NCC>=0.25 and incremental mix variance explained>=0.002
sfx_retrieval.meaning: confidence describes waveform identity evidence only, never semantic fit, audibility or confirmed use count

review_media.frame_end: ceil((effective end+1s)*24), clamped at final video frame count
review_media.video_codec: libx264 CRF21; original mix AAC192k; no audio gain, remix or residual
review_media.exact_audio_sidecar: FLAC derived from decoded original stereo PCM48k, exact sample trim

controls: pure BGM and a separate synthetic mixture of the 3 supplied SFX inserted at fixed arbitrary times; same retrieval and gain subtraction; controls are not engineering truth
interpretation: All results are search hypotheses. Missed or capped matches are uncertainty, not absence. Full final video remains fallback judge input.
